member of the Gosling Society, contributor to MP (1874)

She was author of fiction 1876-95, some of her publications are with her sister Beatrice May Butt (b.

London 1853).

She was probably a Gosling as ‘Staddacombe’ as CMY wrote (May 24th 1875) to Christabel Coleridge supposing so.

She married (1878) John Campbell Robertson Glasgow (1844-1913) and was the author of further works as Geraldine Robertson-Glasgow.

In the 1871 census she was living in Staffordshire with Beatrice and several other sisters and their mother Geraldine May Butt (Quebec 1831-1898).

Her father was Lt.-Col.

Thomas Bromhead Butt.

She was probably the Geraldine Glasgow who contributed to MP (1897). [LG 1952]
